name: EUR/USD 1.10 Breakout Analysis
description: Analyzes how often EUR/USD closes above 1.10 and measures 20-day forward returns after breakout events (first close above 1.10 after being below). Includes frequency statistics, forward return distribution histogram, price chart with 1.10 reference level, and clickable event markers for each breakout.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD 1.10 BREAKOUT ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Event: EUR/USD daily close crosses above 1.10 (first close above after below)
# Forward window: 20 trading days
# Output: Frequency stats, return distribution, price chart, event markers
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# --- Level Detection ---
above_110 = close > 1.10
is_breakout = crossover(close, 1.10)  # True on first close above 1.10 after being at/below

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 20-day forward return from each bar
fwd_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close

# Breakout-specific 20d forward return (null on non-breakout days)
fwd_20d_breakout = where(is_breakout, fwd_20d)

# Hit rate: 1.0 if positive 20d return after breakout, else 0.0
hit_breakout = where(is_breakout, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Frequency Flags ---
# 1.0 on days above 1.10, 0.0 otherwise (Sum → count, Mean → % of period)
above_flag = 1.0 if above_110 else 0.0

# Sparse 1.0 on breakout days only (Count gives event count)
breakout_flag = where(is_breakout, 1.0)

# Close at breakout for event marker display
close_at_breakout = where(is_breakout, close)

# Days since breakout for context in event marker
bars_above = coalesce(barssince()(above_110 == False), 999)
bars_above_at_breakout = where(is_breakout, bars_above)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Frequency & Forward Return Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EUR/USD Above 1.10 — Frequency & Forward Return Stats',
        row_size=6,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Days Above 1.10',
            '% of Period Above 1.10',
            'Breakout Events',
            'Avg +20d Return (Breakout)',
            'Avg +20d Return (All Days)',
            'Hit Rate (Positive +20d)'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Total trading days EUR/USD closed above 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='Proportion of all trading days spent above 1.10'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Distinct breakout events (crosses above 1.10 from below)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Average 20-day forward return starting from breakout day'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Baseline: average 20-day forward return on all days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% of breakouts followed by a positive 20-day return')
        ]
    ),
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Breakout Study',
    order=0
)(above_flag, above_flag, breakout_flag, fwd_20d_breakout, fwd_20d, hit_breakout)

# --- Histogram: Distribution of 20d Forward Returns After Breakout ---
histogram(
    title='Distribution of 20-Day Forward Returns After 1.10 Breakout',
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Breakout Study',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='20-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_20d_breakout)

# --- Chart: EUR/USD Price with 1.10 Reference Level ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Close with 1.10 Level',
    category='EUR/USD 1.10 Breakout Study',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.10, title='1.10 Level', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)

# --- Event Markers: Each Breakout Above 1.10 ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EUR/USD Breakout Above 1.10',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Close Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Forward Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakout, close_at_breakout, fwd_20d_breakout)
